name: FAT atypical cadherin 1

function.text: FAT1 encodes protocadherin Fat 1 [Cleaved into: Protocadherin Fat 1, nuclear form]. Annotated molecular activities include calcium ion binding. It participates in cell adhesion and cell migration.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pleomorphic dermal sarcoma; Metaplastic breast carcinoma; Biphasic hyalinizing psammomatous / NF2-inactivated renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
